purpose: Recompute original paired confidence intervals and inspect influence/energy/boundary association for four inconclusive comparisons, before choosing new local runs.
configuration: Original nearest-lattice noise/physics,4096/5120,512perstate×6states,8cycles,seeds unchanged; exact imported job configs in manifest.
metric: Per-cycle paired higher-minus-lower logical fidelity, equal six-state mean and independent-trajectory stratified95%normal interval; retain ±.01 criterion.
secondary: Descriptive per-trajectory absolute differences, boundary population and photon-energy maxima. Post-hoc sample-size projection assumes same variance/mean and is planning-only, not a promised equivalence result.

decision_rule.support: All original paired intervals wholly in±.01 -> supported within registered scope
decision_rule.contradict: Interval wholly outside tolerance -> discrepancy under fixed criterion
decision_rule.inconclusive: Boundary-crossing interval -> retain inconclusive; no threshold tuning or causal claim from correlations.

execution: Local saved-array calculations only, no new trajectory/randomnoise/training.
